name: ModelVariant162Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant162us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a textured tube spins and swirls around the active slot, a spinning ring of beam sprites rises along the swirl trail and 96 rising sparks around the other slot burst into rings of dots); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the tube mesh and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the sparks start, 4 while they are released, 1 once after the last release, 2 once the last spark has burst and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-179 and 309 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x1C lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
